kind: Frozen four-arm comparison on actual admitted original questions

methods.C: one lexical retrieval then one answer call
methods.D: initial lexical retrieval, one follow-up-query call, second retrieval, one answer call

retrieval_protocol.retrieval_engine: SQLite FTS5 BM25, existing unicode61 remove_diacritics 2 index
retrieval_protocol.initial_query: original English bytes; unique first 48 Unicode alphanumeric terms of length >=2 after fixed stoplist; quoted OR
retrieval_protocol.passage: Expand a query-matching FTS5 snippet into a bounded source-text window; preserve source identity and offset
retrieval_protocol.merge: Reciprocal rank fusion constant 60; source identity (collection,point_id); stable source-identity tie order
retrieval_protocol.duplicate_document: Both distinct round windows retained in round order within one shared formatted-document limit
retrieval_protocol.output_cap_note: No synthetic record cap. Provider max_tokens/length failures are retained, with empty records on a length stop.
retrieval_protocol.source_cutoff_reason: Retained live-Qdrant text snapshot lacks a verified identity/content/cutoff equality witness to the frozen TTL graph.
retrieval_protocol.context_token_count: No verified Anthropic tokenizer available here. Log exact characters, UTF-8 bytes and whitespace terms; actual whole-prompt/completion tokens come only from provider usage.
retrieval_protocol.population_completeness: Corpus existence, lexical match count, selected context and requested-answer completeness are distinct. Finite retrieval cannot certify full requested populations.
retrieval_protocol.reuse: Read-only source corpus only; no prior variants, outputs, task selection or reader protocol reused.

prompt_cost_estimate_note: Estimated from actual frozen prompt characters using chars/3; authoritative tokens/cost are response usage. No claim that this is a tokenizer.
failure_scoring: All IDs retained; execution failure/abstention F1=0/exact=false even for empty gold. Parsed partial records receive matching credit; partial empty output cannot establish empty-gold success.
information_access: Graph and new SQL preserve the frozen record inventory; archive text cutoff/content equality is unverified and finite retrieved context is bounded.
interpretation: One model and a nonrepresentative admitted subset; no storage-medium causal advantage claimed.
SQL_interface: Actual complete value-free physical SQLite DDL; identical cards to SQL interface v2.

replacement_scope.selection: All ten source-audited uncapped top-k contract replacements, fixed before this phase predictions.
replacement_scope.legacy_admitted_n_field_scope: This ten-item phase, not the global original Core admission count.
replacement_scope.legacy_unresolved_n_field_scope: Core IDs outside this replacement phase; no change to the preserved disposition ledger.

repair_validation_before_calls.scope: Recorded separate AI judgments, retained source witnesses and actually replayed scorer controls. No full raw-archive truth or new model performance.

replacement_scope.estimate_scope: Historical four-arm actual spend per item; not a guarantee.

operational_recovery.kind: Only original pre-answer in-flight-budget HTTP402 stages
operational_recovery.retrieval_context_policy: Reuse exact recorded pre-failure rounds and contexts; a first second retrieval after a newly recovered followup uses the same frozen index and limits.
operational_recovery.previous_successful_followup_policy: Reuse exact recorded response without a paid request; record reuse separately.
operational_recovery.score_policy: Preserve original phase; report operationally recovered predictions and any combined results separately.
